notes.note: The roster's four performance columns are asserted only for an Admin: campaign-overview.spec.ts proves Contact/Campaigns/Calls made/Reached from one promoted caller's three assignments, but no row loads /campaigns/callers as a Preacher or Assistant with a non-zero assignment, and a deactivated caller's columns are unasserted. getRosterProgress applies the reader's scope, so the narrowing is code-only.

Each Overview load now reads every campaign twice: listCampaignsWithProgress and getRosterProgress each call listCampaigns and issue one campaign_progress RPC per campaign (4 in flight). On /campaigns/callers that is 2 x (1 + N) reads per page load, and nothing batches the RPC. If a program grows past tens of campaigns, the roster's columns need one scoped aggregate call instead of two per-campaign sweeps.

The roster's 'Campaigns' column is the assignment-grain assigned count, not frame 645's per-campaign pill: getRosterProgress returns one aggregate per caller across every visible campaign, so a per-(caller, campaign) breakdown has no service shape. Reports (Story 3.1) will need that shape for its per-campaign table.
